basis_statement: Only explicit browser-safe keys may cross into browser bundles, browser automation setup, or browser-visible internal viewers.

browser_safe_keys.label: Public base URL
notes: Needed by browser bundles and automation to know which public origin to target.

browser_safe_keys.label: Browser-safe environment label
notes: Safe for UI labels and internal viewer copy.

browser_safe_keys.label: Release channel
notes: Exposes only a coarse release lane, not secret-bearing routing rules.

browser_safe_keys.label: Build SHA
notes: Useful for candidate-bound diagnostics and browser-visible support surfaces.

browser_safe_keys.label: Browser-safe monitoring DSN
notes: Only a public ingest identifier may cross this boundary.
